description: List the OAuth clients currently connected to this tenant through mcphost's own hosted authorization server (host.oauth.issuer_set is for a tenant's own bring-your-own issuer instead): each grant's client_name, method (cimd|dcr), resource, created_at and last_used_at.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.oauth.grants
